tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i lha dbang gi bkol byang bzhugs so/ /hūm̐/ chos rnams rnam dag ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /bya ba byed dang yid chos rnam par dag /nam mkha'i mtha' bzhin kun la snyoms mdzad pa/ /kun bzang yab yum gnyis kyis dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs su 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pas dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ oṃ swā ām̐ hā a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ ngo mtshar pho brang bde bar gshegs pa'i yum/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad skyed mdzad ma/ /rigs kyi yum gyur rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pyām̐ tām̐ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ rnam shes dbang po dag pa sku gsung thugs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras mchog ste/ /sems dpa' chen po brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ /ma hā sa twa a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar can/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i mchod pas rgyal ba mchod/ /byang chub lha mo'i tshogs kyis dbang bskur ro/ /bo dhi de wī a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ bdug spos me tog mar me dri chab ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams la mchod 'bul ma/ /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /pū dza de wī a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa/ /tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi thub par srung*/ /ta kṛd sgo ba bzhi yis dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ rtag chad mthar phyin gsang ba yum gyi ngang*/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma/ /sgo ma chen mo bzhi yis dbang bskur ro/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ steng 'og phyogs bzhi 'jig rten 'dul mdzad gtso/ /nyon mongs drug 'joms rgyud drug dag par sbyong*/ /bcom ldan thub pa drug gis dbang bskur ro/

/sarba mu ne a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dus na mngon byung ba/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dpal chen he ru ka rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /sarba shrī he ru ka a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ khro mo dbang phyug sku la 'khril mdzad cing*/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ma/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad yum gyis dbang bskur ro/ /sarba kro dhi shwa rī a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /ye shes sku mchog 'jigs byed rgyan gyis bzhugs/ /khro mo chen mo brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ /ha a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*/ /'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che/ /phra men chen mo brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ /he a bhi a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi/ /shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi thub par srung*/ /sgo skyong khro mo bzhi yis dbang bskur ro/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñca mi/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badz+ra ā ral+li/ /mkha' la shugs 'gro ma tshogs dbang phyug ma/ /rnal 'byor nyi shu brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo a bhi ṣiñca mi/ shin tu bsdu na/ mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes ni/ /dmigs med shes rab yum gyi ngang du rtogs/ /thugs rje'i bye brag sna tshogs cir yang ston/ /zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal bas dbang bskur ro/ /zhes dang*/ rtsa sngags sam/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad dam pa rigs brgya'i ngo bor dag cing*/ de yang rang sems lhag pa bden gnyis dbyer med gsang chen rigs gcig tu rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes rtog pa bskyed do// //
